// OSINT OPEN ACCESS RESEARCH

> AVIATION TRACKING

MATCHING RECORDS: 4

  • Flight Viz:
    Free, browser-based 3D flight tracking utility built with Rust and WebGL2 rendering 10,000+ live global flights at 60fps without account requirements.
  • Flightradar24:
    Real-time flight tracking service providing live map data on global air traffic, commercial flights, and military aircraft movements.
  • FAA Aircraft Registry:
    Official Federal Aviation Administration search portal tracking U.S. civil aircraft registrations, ownership histories, and airframe data by N-number.
  • Aviation Safety Network:
    A comprehensive public archive detailing historical aircraft accidents, safety incidents, and flight safety investigation records.
